title: 巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction
summary: 透過 24 個概念工序認識三階船閘、節水池、滾動閘門、土建與控制介面，連結通航能力、淡水資源與維護證據。
summaryEn: Use 24 conceptual steps to connect three-chamber locks, water-saving basins, rolling gates and civil-control interfaces with navigation, freshwater and maintenance evidence.
scope: 以公開一次資料為背景的原創工程判讀課程；每步在紙上或數位示意模型中完成。自設數值、構形與工序不得當成原工程的設計、施工、設備操作或驗收程序。
scopeEn: Original engineering interpretation exercises grounded in public primary sources. Complete each step on paper or in a schematic digital model. Invented values, geometry and sequences are not the original project’s design, construction, operating or acceptance procedures.

stages.title: 通航需求與水量邊界
stages.description: 以六個相互銜接的練習完成「通航需求與水量邊界」，保留假設、圖示與判讀證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete six connected exercises on navigation requirements and water balance, retaining assumptions, diagrams and evidence.

steps.title: 畫出兩洋與湖泊的高程關係
steps.titleEn: Map ocean and lake level relationships
steps.objective: 理解船閘如何連接不同水位。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand how locks connect different water levels.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫海洋、閘室及加通湖三類區域；2. 用高程線區分水面；3. 將船移動路線與水移動路線分色。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw ocean, lock chambers and Gatun Lake; 2. distinguish water levels with elevation lines; 3. separate vessel and water routes by color.
steps.observation: 船的前進方向與水流方向不是必然相同。
steps.observationEn: Vessel direction and water-flow direction are not necessarily the same.
steps.failure: 船閘是把海水連續向前推動船舶的單向水管。
steps.failureEn: A lock is a one-way pipe continuously pushing ships forward with seawater.
steps.check: 提交含兩類路徑和水位基準的概念剖面。
steps.checkEn: Submit a conceptual section with two route types and a water-level datum.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 浮船的升降依靠所在水面的變化；閘室是調整水位的空間。
knowledge.textEn: A floating vessel rises or falls with its water surface; a lock chamber provides the changing-level space.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 水位圖描述功能概念，不是實際閘門開閉或通航程序。
knowledge.textEn: The level diagram explains function and is not an actual gate or transit procedure.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘」的「畫出兩洋與湖泊的高程關係」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出流域、入流、儲存、出流與下游的水量邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「水庫數據調度桌」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與同時間窗的流量、水位、截面與儀器校正紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Map ocean and lake level relationships” in “Panama Canal expansion locks”. Draw the catchment, inflow, storage, outflow and downstream water balance; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Reservoir data planning desk” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for flow, level, section and calibration records for the same time window, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 審查「畫出兩洋與湖泊的高程關係」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Map ocean and lake level relationships”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 船的前進方向與水流方向不是必然相同。
船閘是把海水連續向前推動船舶的單向水管。
船舶高度由閘門馬達直接托舉，不受閘室水面影響。
optionsEn: Vessel direction and water-flow direction are not necessarily the same.
A lock is a one-way pipe continuously pushing ships forward with seawater.
Gate motors directly lift vessel elevation independently of chamber water level.
quiz.explanation: 浮船的升降依靠所在水面的變化；閘室是調整水位的空間。 水位圖描述功能概念，不是實際閘門開閉或通航程序。
quiz.explanationEn: A floating vessel rises or falls with its water surface; a lock chamber provides the changing-level space. The level diagram explains function and is not an actual gate or transit procedure.

steps.title: 比較原船閘與擴建船閘
steps.titleEn: Compare original and expanded locks
steps.objective: 避免把兩代設備與尺寸混用。
steps.objectiveEn: Avoid mixing two generations of equipment and dimensions.
steps.instruction: 1. 分別建立原閘與新閘資料卡；2. 標示人字閘門與滾動閘門；3. 記錄每個尺寸所描述的是閘室還是船舶。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Create separate original-lock and expanded-lock records; 2. distinguish miter and rolling gates; 3. identify whether each dimension describes chamber or vessel.
steps.observation: 閘室尺寸與可通航船舶限制不是完全相同的量。
steps.observationEn: Chamber dimensions and permitted vessel limits are not identical quantities.
steps.failure: 把新閘室寬度直接當成任何情境下的允許船寬。
steps.failureEn: Treat new-chamber width as the permissible vessel beam in every circumstance.
steps.check: 輸出含設備世代與資料邊界的比較表。
steps.checkEn: Provide a comparison with equipment generation and data boundaries.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 擴建工程增加新的通航設施；原閘與新閘採用不同閘門及水管理配置。
knowledge.textEn: The expansion added facilities with gate and water-management arrangements different from the original locks.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 船舶限制需額外考慮通航要求，不能只從土建空間推算。
knowledge.textEn: Vessel limits involve navigation requirements beyond the physical civil-work space.

quiz.question: 審查「比較原船閘與擴建船閘」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Compare original and expanded locks”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 把新閘室寬度直接當成任何情境下的允許船寬。
閘室尺寸與可通航船舶限制不是完全相同的量。
原運河人字門與新閘滾動門具有相同運動幾何。
optionsEn: Treat new-chamber width as the permissible vessel beam in every circumstance.
Chamber dimensions and permitted vessel limits are not identical quantities.
Original miter gates and new rolling gates have identical movement geometry.
quiz.explanation: 擴建工程增加新的通航設施；原閘與新閘採用不同閘門及水管理配置。 船舶限制需額外考慮通航要求，不能只從土建空間推算。
quiz.explanationEn: The expansion added facilities with gate and water-management arrangements different from the original locks. Vessel limits involve navigation requirements beyond the physical civil-work space.

steps.title: 拆出三階閘室系統
steps.titleEn: Decompose the three-chamber system
steps.objective: 辨識單一閘室與整組船閘的關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish one chamber from a complete lock flight.
steps.instruction: 1. 串接三個概念閘室；2. 標出相鄰水位邊界；3. 列出每個邊界需協調的水力及設備資訊。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Connect three conceptual chambers; 2. mark adjacent water-level boundaries; 3. list hydraulic and equipment information needed at each boundary.
steps.observation: 一個閘室的狀態可能改變相鄰區的可用條件。
steps.observationEn: The state of one chamber can affect conditions available to neighboring sections.
steps.failure: 三個閘室可以忽略共同邊界而各自獨立任意運作。
steps.failureEn: Three chambers can operate arbitrarily and independently without shared boundaries.
steps.check: 繳交三室及四個邊界的系統圖。
steps.checkEn: Provide a three-chamber diagram with four boundaries.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 串聯系統共享水位與通航介面，局部功能成立不代表整組時序相容。
knowledge.textEn: Series systems share level and navigation interfaces; local function does not establish compatible system timing.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 本圖只表達依賴關係，不給出真實操作順序或設定值。
knowledge.textEn: The diagram expresses dependencies without real operating sequences or settings.

quiz.question: 審查「拆出三階閘室系統」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Decompose the three-chamber system”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 三個閘室可以忽略共同邊界而各自獨立任意運作。
相鄰閘室的水位邊界對彼此沒有影響。
一個閘室的狀態可能改變相鄰區的可用條件。
optionsEn: Three chambers can operate arbitrarily and independently without shared boundaries.
Adjacent chamber-level boundaries have no mutual effect.
The state of one chamber can affect conditions available to neighboring sections.
quiz.explanation: 串聯系統共享水位與通航介面，局部功能成立不代表整組時序相容。 本圖只表達依賴關係，不給出真實操作順序或設定值。
quiz.explanationEn: Series systems share level and navigation interfaces; local function does not establish compatible system timing. The diagram expresses dependencies without real operating sequences or settings.

steps.title: 建立一個完整的水量邊界
steps.titleEn: Define a complete water-balance boundary
steps.objective: 把閘室、節水池與外部水源放入守恆框架。
steps.objectiveEn: Place chambers, saving basins and external water in a conservation framework.
steps.instruction: 1. 選定包住閘室與節水池的邊界；2. 列出進入、流出及儲水變化；3. 用自設體積核對平衡並標示未計入項。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Enclose a chamber and its basins in a boundary; 2. list inflow, outflow and storage change; 3. reconcile invented volumes and identify omitted terms.
steps.observation: 內部回用流量不應再次計為從湖泊新增取水。
steps.observationEn: Internal reuse should not be counted again as new withdrawal from the lake.
steps.failure: 把每一段內部水流都加進外部耗水量。
steps.failureEn: Add every internal transfer to external water consumption.
steps.check: 提交一次守恆計算與明確的系統邊界。
steps.checkEn: Submit one conservation calculation with an explicit system boundary.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 水量守恆取決於邊界定義，內部轉移在整體帳中應相互抵消。
knowledge.textEn: Water conservation depends on boundary definition; internal transfers cancel in the overall balance.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 自設例子不對應真實航次用水，實況還需水位及營運資料。
knowledge.textEn: The invented example is not real transit consumption, which requires level and operating data.

quiz.question: 審查「建立一個完整的水量邊界」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Define a complete water-balance boundary”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 內部回用流量不應再次計為從湖泊新增取水。
把每一段內部水流都加進外部耗水量。
內部轉移與外部取水在任何邊界下都是同一項。
optionsEn: Internal reuse should not be counted again as new withdrawal from the lake.
Add every internal transfer to external water consumption.
Internal transfer and external withdrawal are identical under every boundary definition.
quiz.explanation: 水量守恆取決於邊界定義，內部轉移在整體帳中應相互抵消。 自設例子不對應真實航次用水，實況還需水位及營運資料。
quiz.explanationEn: Water conservation depends on boundary definition; internal transfers cancel in the overall balance. The invented example is not real transit consumption, which requires level and operating data.

steps.title: 辨認節水比例的分母
steps.titleEn: Identify the denominator in a saving ratio
steps.objective: 區分回用比例、耗水差異與總取水。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish reuse fraction, consumption difference and total withdrawal.
steps.instruction: 1. 寫出原始取水及回用的假想數據；2. 用兩個不同分母計算百分比；3. 說明為何不能把百分比直接相加。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Write hypothetical withdrawal and reuse values; 2. calculate percentages using two denominators; 3. explain why those percentages cannot simply be added.
steps.observation: 節水百分比需要交代比較對象與分母才具有意義。
steps.observationEn: A saving percentage needs a comparison basis and denominator to be meaningful.
steps.failure: 兩份資料都寫節水就可把百分比相加得到總效果。
steps.failureEn: Two reported saving percentages can be added to obtain total benefit.
steps.check: 輸出每個百分比的公式、分母及適用範圍。
steps.checkEn: Provide a formula, denominator and scope for each percentage.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 回用同一水體與減少外部取水是相關但不相同的指標。
knowledge.textEn: Reusing water and reducing external withdrawal are related but distinct metrics.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 官方發表的回用性能應連同測試或設計背景閱讀，不能推成每次航行保證。
knowledge.textEn: Published reuse performance needs its design or test context and is not a guarantee for every transit.

quiz.question: 審查「辨認節水比例的分母」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Identify the denominator in a saving ratio”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 兩份資料都寫節水就可把百分比相加得到總效果。
節水百分比需要交代比較對象與分母才具有意義。
同樣百分比在不同分母下代表相同節水體積。
optionsEn: Two reported saving percentages can be added to obtain total benefit.
A saving percentage needs a comparison basis and denominator to be meaningful.
The same percentage under different denominators means the same saved volume.
quiz.explanation: 回用同一水體與減少外部取水是相關但不相同的指標。 官方發表的回用性能應連同測試或設計背景閱讀，不能推成每次航行保證。
quiz.explanationEn: Reusing water and reducing external withdrawal are related but distinct metrics. Published reuse performance needs its design or test context and is not a guarantee for every transit.

steps.title: 審查通航與水資源需求
steps.titleEn: Review navigation and water-resource needs
steps.objective: 理解航運服務與流域其他用途的共同依賴。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand shared dependence of shipping and other watershed uses.
steps.instruction: 1. 畫通航、居民用水及湖泊蓄水三個需求節點；2. 連到共同水源；3. 列出一項增加通航能力仍不能回答的資源問題。
steps.instructionEn: 1. Draw navigation, public-water and storage demand nodes; 2. connect them to shared water; 3. identify a resource question increased navigation capacity cannot answer.
steps.observation: 更大的船閘不能單獨保證任何乾旱條件下都有足夠淡水。
steps.observationEn: Larger locks alone cannot guarantee sufficient freshwater under every drought condition.
steps.failure: 增加閘室尺寸會自動增加流域可用水量。
steps.failureEn: Increasing chamber size automatically increases available watershed water.
steps.check: 繳交通航、儲水及供水需求矩陣。
steps.checkEn: Provide a navigation, storage and water-supply requirements matrix.

knowledge.title: 機理與邊界
knowledge.text: 工程容量與自然資源供給屬不同約束，兩者需在同一系統範圍下協調。
knowledge.textEn: Engineering capacity and natural supply are different constraints requiring coordination within one system boundary.

knowledge.title: 證據與推論
knowledge.text: 本課程不推定當前水位、通航限額或政策；這些需查最新營運公告。
knowledge.textEn: The course does not infer current levels, transit limits or policy, which require current operator notices.

quiz.question: 審查「審查通航與水資源需求」時，哪個判讀有根據？
quiz.questionEn: When reviewing “Review navigation and water-resource needs”, which interpretation is justified?
options: 增加閘室尺寸會自動增加流域可用水量。
自然降雨與工程容量是可以互相替代的相同約束。
更大的船閘不能單獨保證任何乾旱條件下都有足夠淡水。
optionsEn: Increasing chamber size automatically increases available watershed water.
Natural rainfall and engineering capacity are interchangeable constraints.
Larger locks alone cannot guarantee sufficient freshwater under every drought condition.
quiz.explanation: 工程容量與自然資源供給屬不同約束，兩者需在同一系統範圍下協調。 本課程不推定當前水位、通航限額或政策；這些需查最新營運公告。
quiz.explanationEn: Engineering capacity and natural supply are different constraints requiring coordination within one system boundary. The course does not infer current levels, transit limits or policy, which require current operator notices.
